```{python}
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
# Load in the name database
url = "https://posit.byui.edu/content/0d43d66f-d3b7-4c43-8c36-52e3ed69e7f1/names_year_csv.csv"
df = pl.read_csv(url)
```


```{python}
# filter the data to only include Elliot

display(df.columns)

df = df.filter(pl.col("name") == "Elliot")

display(df)
```

```{python}

(
    ggplot(df, aes(x="year", y="Total"))
    + geom_line(aes(color="name"), size=1.2)
    + scale_color_manual(values={"name": "blue"})

    + geom_vline(xintercept=1982, color="red", linetype="dashed", size=1.1)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=1984, color="red", linetype="dashed", size=1.1)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=2002, color="red", linetype="dashed", size=1.1)

    + geom_text(x=1980, y=2950, label="E.T. Released", hjust='right', vjust='bottom')
    + geom_text(x=1985, y=2950, label="Second Release", hjust='left', vjust='bottom')
    + geom_text(x=2003, y=2950, label="Third Release", hjust='left', vjust='bottom')

    + scale_x_continuous(format="d")
    + scale_y_continuous(format="d")

    + coord_cartesian(xlim=(1950, 2025))

    + labs(
        title="Elliot... What?",
        x="Year",
        y='',
    )
    
    + theme_gray()

    + theme(
        axis_ticks_length_y=0,
        axis_ticks_length_x=0,
        plot_title=element_text(face="italic", size=24),
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        legend_position="right",
        legend_justification="top"
    )
)


```
